name: Piz Buin
beschreibung: The Hotel Piz Buin is located in the center of Ischgl, just a few minutes' walk from the Silvretta Seilbahn. The hotel offers cozy rooms with traditional Alpine decor and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. Guests appreciate the central location and direct access to the ski slopes as well as the hiking trails of the Verwalltal. A sauna is available for relaxation.
